parole.significato: baobarang, false black pepper (Embelia ribes; also Embelia tsjeriam-cottam syn. Embelia robusta)
parole.testo: From Persian برنگ (berang), from Sanskrit विडङ्ग (viḍaṅga), विडङ्गा (viḍaṅgā), also in Classical Syriac ܒܪܢܓ (brng), and more directly borrowed into Arabic as فِلَنْجَة (filanja).

parole.significato: galangal (Alpinia gen. et spp. and especially Alpinia officinarum)
parole.testo: From Persian قولنجان (qulanjân, qulenjân), from Sanskrit कुलञ्जन (kulañjana), possibly from Chinese 高良薑／高良姜 (gāoliángjiāng).

parole.significato: rock sugar (originally: the solidified sap of the sugarcane)
parole.testo: From Persian کند (kand, “candied sugar”), from Sanskrit खण्ड (khaṇḍa, “scrap, broken piece, candied sugar, dried molasses”).

parole.significato: screw pine (Pandanus spp., especially Pandanus odorifer (syn. Pandanus odoratissimus))
parole.testo: From Persian کادی (kâdi), from Sanskrit केतक (ketaka, “screw pine”).
From Persian ماش (mâš), from Sanskrit माष (māṣa, “mungo bean”).
